```{=html}
<style>#title-block-header { display: none; }
#circle-of-fifths-root { margin-top: -50px; }
#circle-of-fifths-root * { box-sizing: border-box; }

#cof-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  padding: 1rem clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.5rem);
}

/* Landscape: rail of controls hugs the left margin, stacked vertically. Each select is
   sized to its own longest option (native <select> intrinsic width), not a shared column
   width, so labels never get cut off. */
#cof-rail {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;
}
.side-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.side-panel label {
  font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--parch-dim); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.side-panel select {
  font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: .375rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--site-border);
  background: var(--site-surface); color: var(--site-ink);
  cursor: pointer; outline: none; width: auto;
  transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
}
.side-panel select:hover { border-color: var(--site-accent-dk); }
.side-panel select:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--site-accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--site-accent-bg);
}
#right-panel { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .15s; }
#right-panel.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

#canvas-wrap { flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; min-width: 0; }
#cof-host { width: min(100%, calc(100vh - 120px)); }

/* Portrait / narrow viewport: controls move below the wheel, laid out in a row, shifted
   right so they don't sit under the fixed bottom-left "Establish tonality" button. */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  #circle-of-fifths-root { margin-top: -25px; }
  #cof-wrap { flex-direction: column; padding: 1rem; gap: 1rem; }
  #cof-rail {
    order: 2; width: 100%;
    flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 10px 14px;
    padding-left: 18vw;
  }
  #canvas-wrap { order: 1; width: 100%; }
  #cof-host { width: 100%; }
  /* Stack the shared floating button's words so it reads taller/narrower instead of
     a wide single-line strip competing with the rail for horizontal room. */
  #establish-tonality-btn {
    width: 62px; white-space: normal; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2;
  }
}
</style>

<div id="circle-of-fifths-root"><div id="cof-wrap">
  <div id="cof-rail">
    <div class="side-panel" id="keysig-panel">
      <label for="keysig-select">Sharps / Flats</label>
      <select id="keysig-select"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="side-panel" id="left-panel">
      <label>Tonality</label>
      <select id="mode-select">
        <option value="0" selected="selected">Major (do)</option>
        <option value="1">Dorian (re)</option>
        <option value="2">Phrygian (mi)</option>
        <option value="3">Lydian (fa)</option>
        <option value="4">Mixo (so)</option>
        <option value="5">Minor (la)</option>
        <option value="7">Locrian (ti)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="side-panel" id="names-panel">
      <label for="names-select">Note names</label>
      <select id="names-select"></select>
    </div>
    <div class="side-panel" id="right-panel">
      <label>Minor type</label>
      <select id="minor-mode">
        <option value="6">Harmonic</option>
        <option value="5">Natural (Aeolian)</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="canvas-wrap">
    <div id="cof-host"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="/apps/shared/degree-names.js?v=1"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/tonality.js?v=10"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/audio.js?v=10"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/circle-of-fifths.js?v=2"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  // The wheel is the shared component (apps/shared/circle-of-fifths.js). This page adds the menus around it, the shared key
  // (Tonality, always CONCERT pitch) and a Transposition lens: the wheel itself shows the WRITTEN pitch, the shared store and the
  // chord that sounds are concert pitch.
  var MODES=CircleOfFifths.MODES;
  var C_MODE = {maj:0,major:0,ion:0,ionian:0, m:6,min:6,minor:6, aeo:5,aeolian:5, dor:1,dorian:1, phr:2,phrygian:2, lyd:3,lydian:3, mix:4,mixolydian:4, loc:7,locrian:7};
  var OUR_MODE = {0:"maj",1:"dor",2:"phr",3:"lyd",4:"mix",5:"aeo",6:"m",7:"loc"};
  var FIRST_OF_TONIC = {"do":0,re:1,mi:2,fa:3,so:4,la:6,ti:7};   // the Tonality menu picks Harmonic first for La
  var LA_MODES=[5,6];
  var NAMES=["C","D♭","D","E♭","E","F","G♭","G","A♭","A","B♭","B"];
  var TRANSPOSITIONS=[{value:0,label:"Concert pitch"},{value:2,label:"B♭"},{value:9,label:"E♭"},{value:7,label:"F"}];
  var MODE_WORD=['Major','Dorian','Phrygian','Lydian','Mixo','Minor',null,'Locrian'];
  var SYL_SEMI={"do":0,re:2,mi:4,fa:5,so:7,la:9,ti:11};
  var applying=false;
  var modeSelect=document.getElementById('mode-select'), minorSelect=document.getElementById('minor-mode'), rightPanel=document.getElementById('right-panel'), keySigSelect=document.getElementById('keysig-select');
  var vSel=null;

  var wheel=CircleOfFifths.mount(document.getElementById('cof-host'),{
    rings:"roman,notes,syllables", keysig:true, undo:true, sound:true,
    transpose:function(){ return vSel ? (parseInt(vSel.value,10)||0) : 0; },
    onChange:function(st,src){ syncUI(st); if(src!=="tonality") publish(); }
  });
  function transSemis(){ return vSel ? (parseInt(vSel.value,10)||0) : 0; }

  // the menus down the left
  for(var ks=-7;ks<=7;ks++){var o=document.createElement('option');o.value=String(ks);o.textContent=ks===0?'0 (♮)':Math.abs(ks)+(ks>0?'♯':'♭');keySigSelect.appendChild(o);}
  function syncUI(st){
    st=st||wheel.state();
    modeSelect.value=LA_MODES.indexOf(st.mode)>=0?'5':String(st.mode);
    minorSelect.value=String(st.mode);
    rightPanel.classList.toggle('visible',LA_MODES.indexOf(st.mode)>=0);
    keySigSelect.value=Math.abs(st.keySig)<=7?String(st.keySig):'';
    syncBar();
  }
  modeSelect.addEventListener('change',function(){ wheel.set({mode:FIRST_OF_TONIC[MODES[parseInt(modeSelect.value)].tonic]},'picker'); });
  minorSelect.addEventListener('change',function(){ wheel.set({mode:parseInt(minorSelect.value)},'picker'); });
  keySigSelect.addEventListener('change',function(){ wheel.setKeySig(parseInt(keySigSelect.value)); });
  function modeOptionNames(){   // "Dorian (re)" in solfege, "Dorian (2)" in scale degrees, "Dorian (Re)" in Sargam (a menu cannot draw the caret)
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(modeSelect.options,function(o){
      var i=+o.value,t=MODES[i].tonic;
      o.textContent=MODE_WORD[i]+' ('+(DegreeNames.get()==='solfege'?t:DegreeNames.label(SYL_SEMI[t],{doPc:0,restPc:0}).replace(/\u0302/g,''))+')';
    });
  }
  DegreeNames.bind(document.getElementById('names-select'));
  DegreeNames.onChange(modeOptionNames);
  modeOptionNames();

  // Concert Key / Transposition / Transposed Key, just below the Sharps/Flats menu
  var rail=document.getElementById("cof-rail");
  var keyGroup=document.createElement("div"); keyGroup.id="cof-keybar"; keyGroup.style.cssText="display:contents";
  var transOptions=TRANSPOSITIONS.map(function(t){ return '<option value="'+t.value+'">'+t.label+'</option>'; }).join('');
  keyGroup.innerHTML='<div class="side-panel" id="cofTransWrap" style="display:none"><label for="cofTrans" id="cofTransLbl">Transposed Key</label><select id="cofTrans"></select></div>'+
    '<div class="side-panel" id="cof-concert-panel"><label for="cofConcert">Concert Key</label><select id="cofConcert"></select></div>'+
    '<div class="side-panel" id="cof-view-panel"><label for="cofView">Transposition</label><select id="cofView">'+transOptions+'</select></div>';
  rail.insertBefore(keyGroup, document.getElementById("left-panel"));
  var cSel=document.getElementById("cofConcert"), tSel=document.getElementById("cofTrans"), tWrap=document.getElementById("cofTransWrap"), tLbl=document.getElementById("cofTransLbl");
  vSel=document.getElementById("cofView");
  var h=""; for(var pc=0;pc<12;pc++) h+='<option value="'+pc+'">'+NAMES[pc]+'</option>'; cSel.innerHTML=h;
  function transLabel(){ var v=transSemis(); var t=TRANSPOSITIONS.filter(function(t){return t.value===v;})[0]; return t?t.label:""; }
  function publish(){
    if(applying) return;
    try{
      var st=wheel.state(), resting=((st.root-transSemis())%12+12)%12;     // the wheel shows the written pitch; the shared store holds concert
      var doPc=(((resting + MODES[st.mode].fifthsOffset*7) % 12) + 12) % 12;
      Tonality.setAll(doPc, resting, OUR_MODE[st.mode], "local");
    }catch(e){}
    syncBar();
  }
  function applyTonality(st){
    if (!st || st.resting == null){ syncBar(); return; }
    var m = C_MODE[st.mode] != null ? C_MODE[st.mode] : 0, written = ((st.resting + transSemis())%12+12)%12, cur=wheel.state();
    if (cur.root===written && cur.mode===m){ syncBar(); return; }
    applying=true; wheel.set({root:written, mode:m},'tonality'); applying=false;
  }
  function syncBar(){
    var rest = Tonality.getResting(); if(rest==null) return; var ts=transSemis();
    cSel.value=String(rest);
    var ksLbl=document.querySelector('label[for="keysig-select"]');
    if(ksLbl) ksLbl.textContent = ts ? "Sharps / Flats (written)" : "Sharps / Flats";
    tWrap.style.display = ts ? "" : "none";
    if(ts){ tLbl.textContent="Transposed Key ("+transLabel()+")";
      var hh=""; for(var p=0;p<12;p++) hh+='<option value="'+p+'">'+NAMES[p]+'</option>'; tSel.innerHTML=hh; tSel.value=String((rest+ts)%12); }
  }
  function curSt(){ return { do: Tonality.getDo(), resting: Tonality.getResting(), mode: Tonality.getMode() }; }
  function pick(restPc){ var mode=Tonality.getMode()||"maj"; var mi=C_MODE[mode]!=null?C_MODE[mode]:0;
    var off=MODES[mi].fifthsOffset; var doPc=(((restPc+off*7)%12)+12)%12; Tonality.setAll(doPc, restPc, mode, "local"); applyTonality(curSt()); }
  cSel.addEventListener("change", function(){ pick(parseInt(cSel.value,10)||0); });
  tSel.addEventListener("change", function(){ var written=parseInt(tSel.value,10)||0; pick(((written-transSemis())%12+12)%12); });
  vSel.addEventListener("change", function(){ applyTonality(curSt()); });
  Tonality.onChange(function(st, src){ if (src !== "local") applyTonality(st); else syncBar(); });

  if (curSt().resting != null) applyTonality(curSt()); else publish();
  syncUI();
  window.__cof = wheel;
})();
</script>
<script src="/apps/shared/establish-button.js?v=1"></script>
```
